mac.kick.header.no_client_mod:
Connection refused: the client does not have "Mod Access Control" installed.
This server requires all clients to install this mod for access verification.
mac.kick.header.protocol:
Access protocol version mismatch (server=%s, client=%s).
Please update the mod from the channel specified by the server.
mac.kick.header.loader:
Incompatible mod loader: the server requires %s, your client uses %s.
Please use the same mod loader as the server.
mac.kick.header.timeout: Access verification timed out. If the mod is installed, restart the game and retry; if it persists, contact the server administrator.
mac.kick.header.violation: Access verification failed. Problems found in your client mod list:
mac.kick.header.mac_version:
Connection refused: this mod version is not on the server's allow list.
Allowed versions: %s; your version: %s.
mac.kick.hint.generic: Hint: install the correct mod versions required by the server and rejoin.
mac.kick.hint.timeout: Hint: if this keeps failing, try updating your game/mod version and reconnect.
mac.kick.hint.violation: Hint: remove or add the mods listed above and rejoin; contact server staff if unsure.
mac.kick.hint.mac_version: Hint: update or switch Mod Access Control to the version required by the server and rejoin.
